Two closed manufacturer enums (hvacHeatingSystemManufacturer, dhwManufacturer) both hit a real, named brand ('Burnham', 'Amtrol') that is not on Snugg's published list -- schema.ts's own docstring names Burnham as the worked example of the 'Other' catch-all (RECONCILIATION.md ruling 1). An indirect DHW tank maps to 'Sidearm Tank' per schema.ts's own gloss. A depth-only attic reading (six inches of cellulose, no R-value spoken) exercises atticInsulationDepth without ever touching atticInsulation (rule 7 -- no derivation). A declared-absent BTU output (painted-over plate). Two clean-result health tests stated as positive data (gas/oil-line sniffer, draft) rather than silence (rule 8). A narrow blanket disclaimer ('No blower door today') mapping to the blowerDoor named set. Two non-conflicting DHW age sources (an eight-year estimate and a 2017 install-sticker year) that corroborate rather than retract each other, with the bare install year having no write target of its own.

notes.hvac.hvacHeatingSystemManufacturer: 'Burnham' is a real boiler manufacturer not on HvacHeatingSystemManufacturer's closed list. schema.ts's own comment on this enum names Burnham specifically as the example of a real-but-unlisted make that maps to 'Other' -- a mechanical vocabulary mapping (RECONCILIATION.md ruling 1), not a contested reading; not marked arguable.
notes.dhw.dhwManufacturer: 'Amtrol' (a real indirect/sidearm-tank manufacturer) is likewise absent from DhwManufacturer's closed list. Same ruling-1 catch-all logic as the hvac manufacturer leaf: maps to 'Other', not noFittingMember, because 'Other' is a real, fitting member.
notes.hvac.hvacHeatingSystemModel: The plate reads 'V8'; 'V-eight series' is the auditor phonetically spelling out the same model number for dictation, not a second, different model detail. Recorded as the bare model number.
notes.dhw.dhwAge: 'about eight years old' and 'the install sticker says twenty seventeen' are offered as corroborating detail, not a retraction of each other (no 'no wait' / 'scratch that' language, and the two figures are consistent under an ordinary audit date). Only the spoken age band is asserted -- the bare 2017 install year has no write target in this schema (dhwAge is a band from a stated AGE, not a year) and is not converted or forced into one.
notes.health.healthGasLeak: 'no gas smell obviously it's oil, but no leaks at the fittings either, all dry' is a real, performed sniffer/leak check with a clean result -- this is rule 8's own 'gas sniffer was quiet' example, essentially verbatim, so it is asserted Passed with no hedge. (One annotator flagged this as possibly not addressing a true GAS-leak test on an oil system with no gas piping; see RECONCILIATION.md -- resolved as a clean Passed, not arguable, because a dry-fittings result on a performed sniffer sweep is exactly the rule-8 pattern, and this is the only leaf a fittings/leak check could plausibly address.)
notes._general: Two details are said out loud but have no leaf anywhere in the 51: the bulk fuel-oil storage tank itself ('two-seventy-five gallon, about two-thirds full' -- a fuel-supply tank, distinct from the 40-gallon DHW tank dhwTankSize describes) and the boiler's construction material ('cast iron sections'). Both deliberately excluded per rule 9, not missed. attic.atticInsulation (the R-value leaf) is never stated -- only a depth -- and stays unmentioned, never derived from the six-inch depth. hvac.hvacUpgradeAction, hvac.hvacCoolingCapacity, every basedata leaf besides the blower-door pair (covered by the disclaimer), every wall and window leaf, dhw.dhwLocation, and every health leaf besides healthGasLeak/healthDraftPressure are never addressed at all in this transcript.
